EXT.evidence: No clear signs of outgoing or energetic behavior; only brief, matter-of-fact remarks.

AGR.evidence: Takes partial responsibility for the problem (“I guess it’s partially my fault”) rather than blaming others.

CON.evidence: Reflects on a poor decision and proposes a safer, more appropriate alternative (pen or pencil), showing responsibility and care.

NEU.evidence: Expresses self-doubt and guilt by taking blame and second-guessing the earlier choice.

OPN.evidence: Prefers a conventional, cautious option (pen/pencil) over the unusual idea (monkey).
